findings.mechanism: Correlation identifiers generated per service rather than propagated by the transport; logs cannot be queried per request because no request ID is included.
findings.remediation: Propagate a request correlation ID (e.g., X-Request-ID) from the caller through to outbound HTTP headers and include it in all log statements within this function.
findings.arithmetic: Without a correlation ID, each log line (e.g., the warning on line 34) cannot be linked to a specific charge request, making it impossible for on‑call to trace a failure to a single request.
